needs.what: Shader keys do not mask the control-section bytes this engine varies: every variant is translated separately (slow first use).
The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.
Presents are not re-paced to the display: the game keeps the present interval it asks for (often 30 fps).

nxnative gives this game a 5.25 GB alias region (nxweb: 1.87 GB); a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).
